description:
Use this when the user asks to report a problem with DalalOS data or tools, or to request a feature, or agrees after you offer to report a likely DalalOS issue. Not for questions about a company; it sends a report to the DalalOS team and does not change any data.

Its only write: it saves the report in DalalOS's own store and returns a report ID; it uses no credits. Required: `category`, `summary` (up to 160 characters), `details` (up to 2,000) and `request_id`, a new UUID for each report, reused only to retry the same report. Optional: `related_tool`, `security_identifier` with `security_identifier_type` (both or neither), `metric`, `observed_value` and `expected_value` (with units, up to 200 characters each), `as_of_date` and `source_reference`. Send only what the report needs: no conversation text, credentials, contact details or holdings. Say whether the problem is suspected or confirmed. A failure of this tool is not something to report with it. On success, give the user `data.message` with the report ID; it is not yet reviewed; the team does not reply to individual reports. Needs a signed-in DalalOS account.
name: submit_dalalos_feedback
title: Send DalalOS feedback
